cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en mayo de 2026? Indica el proveedor, la serie, el número y el saldo pendiente de cada factura.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, COALESCE(pi.total_amount, 0) - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi JOIN public.supplier AS s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.business_name, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount LIMIT 50
